display.label: Managed Service for Apache Kafka
display.description: A managed Apache Kafka cluster with its topics, reachable privately from a VPC subnet

globals.label: Project ID
globals.description: GCP Project ID in which the Kafka cluster will be created.

resource.key_description: Name of the Kafka cluster. Clients and topics refer to the cluster by this id.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Identity and region of the cluster.

validation.pattern_error: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The cluster and all of its topics live in this region.

fields.label: Labels
fields.description: Labels applied to the cluster, provided as a map.

sections.label: Capacity
sections.description: Compute and memory allocated to the cluster. Both can be raised later.

fields.label: Memory (GiB)
fields.description: Google requires between 1 GiB and 8 GiB per vCPU, so 3 vCPUs allow 3 to 24 GiB.

fields.label: Rebalance behaviour
fields.description: Whether partitions are redistributed automatically when the cluster scales up.

sections.label: Networking
sections.description: The cluster is reachable privately, through a subnet in the chosen region.

fields.label: Host project ID
fields.description: Only for Shared VPC, when the subnet belongs to a host project. Leave blank to use the project above.

fields.label: Subnet
fields.description: Subnet the cluster's private endpoint is placed in. It must be in the cluster's region.

sections.label: Topics
sections.description: Topics created on the cluster. More can be added later without disturbing the cluster.

fields.label: Partitions
fields.description: Can be increased later, never decreased.

fields.label: Replication factor
fields.description: Must not exceed the number of brokers. 3 is the usual choice for production.

fields.label: Topic configuration
fields.description: Kafka topic settings as a map, for example cleanup.policy or retention.ms.
